info.value: Good afternoon, boys and girls. Here’s a notice. I want to tell you something about our school trip. We’re going to visit the Space Museum on September 5th, this Friday. We’ll have to leave school at 8:30, so don’t be late. We’ll get there by bus. What’s next? Oh, yes, the cost. It’ll be 40 yuan each student. And I will give you some work to do at the museum. So please remember to take a pen and a notebook to write down something. That’s all. Thank you and have a nice day.
